title: Calendar view bar uses the redesign words, with Coming soon on Day, Week, Timeline and calendar sync

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-22: plug the Space calendar redesign into what exists, Coming soon on the rest

detail: FILED 2026-10-22. THE CONSEQUENCE: the calendar said Grid, List and Workflow while the redesign says Month, Agenda and Board, and the design's Day, Week, Timeline and Google/Apple/Outlook/Notion sync were nowhere, so nobody could tell they were planned. THE FIX: the view bar reads Month, Agenda, Board (same three surfaces, same cookie); a Coming soon line names Day, Week and Timeline for the team; the calendar settings carry a Two-way sync list with the shared mark on each provider; a visitor's heading reads What's happening. Plan: /mnt/project-files/calendar/calendar-redesign-plan-2026-10-22.md.

verify.note: Fails on main (Grid/List/Workflow, no marks), passes with this change.
